name: Greenpanel Industries Limited
summary: Greenpanel Industries Limited engages in the manufacturing and sale of plywood, medium density fibre board (MDF), and allied products under the Greenpanel brand name in India and internationally. The company provides high-density fibreboard, fire-resistant, pre-laminated, and veneered MDF, wooden flooring, block boards, and doors. Greenpanel Industries Limited was incorporated in 2017 and is based in Gurugram, India.
